basic_info.name: Verbalize Your English
basic_info.description: Verbalize Your English (VYE) is a coaching-focused English communication program designed to assist multilingual professionals, students, and leaders in speaking clearly, confidently, and authentically.Unlike traditional methods, we don’t rely on textbooks. Instead, we employ a neuroscience-driven, conversation-centric approach to equip clients for real-world, high-stakes situations such as leading meetings, handling interviews, expressing personality, and working across cultures.Founded and led by Seep Anand, a SENCE-certified relator & a Trinity CertTESOL-certified coach with over 20 years of cross-cultural experience, VYE integrates adult learning science, psychology-informed coaching, and strategic communication techniques.We have supported learners from more than 10 countries across diverse sectors including law, finance, technology, education, and the arts.Whether you are an executive, student, immigrant, or emerging professional, VYE adapts to your needs and helps you build confident, effective English skills for the moments that matter most.

basic_info.name: Verbalize Training
basic_info.description: Most professionals don’t struggle with English. They struggle with using it effectively at work.Meetings lack structure. Explanations are unclear. Decisions are not communicated precisely. The result is friction, misunderstandings, and lost impact.Verbalize helps professionals perform in English in real business situations.We work with teams and individuals in international environments to improve how they run meetings, explain ideas and decisions, present complex information clearly, and communicate with confidence and precision.Our approach is practical and structured. Instead of general language training, we focus on how communication actually works in the workplace.Participants learn clear communication frameworks they can apply immediately, the language needed to support those frameworks, and how to use both under real conditions.This leads to measurable improvements in clarity, efficiency, and confidence.Training is delivered online or in hybrid formats, tailored to the specific needs of each team.If your team needs to operate more effectively in English, let’s talk.
